reason: parse_enum strips whitespace but compares case-sensitively (`if tok not in allowed`) and returns the raw token, so ' HIGH ' raises ValueError('unknown_enum:HIGH') instead of returning the canonical 'High'. The added test tests/test_enum_coerce.py::test_parse_enum_case_insensitive would therefore fail, contradicting the report's 0 failures. parse_enum_list inherits the same bug. Fix: match case-insensitively (e.g., build a map from entry.casefold() to canonical entry) and return the canonical entry from `allowed`.
target_issue: Req 1: case-insensitive matching in parse_enum (failing test: tests/test_enum_coerce.py::test_parse_enum_case_insensitive)
